payload.recallText: I'm in my last unit of teaching this third grade class. In this unit we are going over to to live during the Oregon trail.Usually I am not a very serious teacher. When learning a new part of history I like to create it realistically for my kids, like a puppet, however it feels difficult to do the Oregon trail realistically because of how difficult it was. I came up with a plan were we would walk 2 miles, which would be a lot for 9 year old. So we started the day with this, and I told the they could choose a last name from someone that died on that trail. We also picked occupations, but the girl said they wanted to be a pop stars and I said there were no pop stars back then. We decided on farmer, miner and some doctors. One kid was thirsty and I tried telling him there was no stream of water but it didn't seem okay to not give kid water when they wanted it so we pretended there was a stream.
